notes.title: Adult content is being banned across all platforms - Including my games
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all, I'm the kinky developer behind "Animus Non Grata" and "Jessica's Plight", as well as the WIP projects "Taru's Infernal Pledge" and "Neuro/Splice".

Animus Non Grata has been banned by Steam for violating the new payment processor rules. The same is likely going to happen to all my games on all platforms, including Jessica's Plight.

Us developers need your help to fight this censorship and anti-consumer practices. We cannot do it alone. Raise awareness of the issue, you can find plenty of information online.

For now, it looks like I won't be able to conduct business on Steam. The future is unknown, but you can join my discord server for more updates: https://discord.gg/zyP8qgsDzk 

Your Truly,
FlimsyLegs[/p]

notes.title: Huge thank you to Abstraction for their music!

Cheers,
FlimsyLegs
